summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. reporting the results of its 2026 annual general and special meeting of shareholders. Items approved include an amendment to remove the automatic conversion feature of Multiple Voting Shares, an option exchange program for up to 10,070,478 stock options, and a plan of arrangement to continue the company from British Columbia to Delaware. All items received overwhelming shareholder approval, with the arrangement approved by 99.93% of votes cast. The filing is a routine post-meeting report and does not constitute a special situation event.
